item.title: Taj Burrow Went Surfing at Surf Abu Dhabi With His (Ripping) Dad
item.description: Taj Burrow has achieved the status of living legend. Taj's father is proud of his son. That pride was on display during a session at Surf Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Video: Surfer Stranded on Rock For 30 Hours Rescued
